notes: Claude Code and Claude Desktop can reach your Kit again. If you turned either of them on, they were trying to start your Kit from a folder that has never existed, and failed instantly with a missing-file error every time. Restarting did not help, because nothing about it was temporary. They now look where your Kit actually lives. If you moved files by hand to work around this, you can put them back: the fix does not need them.
This affects Kits running without Docker. Everything else, including your memories, your surfaces and your settings, was untouched by it: only the doorway those two apps knock on was wrong.
